protocol.secondary: all four task AUC and unweighted Logloss; mean AUC reported separately
protocol.gradient_clip_scope: dense parameters only, following upstream split optimizer training
protocol.precision: bf16 autocast; TF32 disabled; no torch.compile
protocol.history_visibility: Exact released prefix/action inputs. Delayed feedback may not be mature at prediction time; results only establish this offline benchmark.
protocol.training: scratch; official single-pass recipe adapted to DIN; sum four BCE unless declared training-loss hook
protocol.baseline: Initial empirical reference: DIN local activation over item-field history with action values and four separate heads; field/task adaptation, not exact original DIN reproduction
protocol.research_goal: Explore and validate mechanism-distinct unified modeling of multi-field user/context/target features and multi-feedback behavior histories. Develop representations and information flow that jointly support sequence modeling, feature interaction and task prediction under the fixed data and compute protocol.

architecture_search.scope: Whole-model design, including replacement of the initial network and all internal representations.
design_dimensions: Representation units: fields, events, behavior groups, learned slots and target/task tokens.
Information flow: stacked interaction, layer-wise joint interaction, parallel exchange, learned routing or other testable unified structures.
History selection/compression jointly designed with target/context-conditioned retrieval.
Derived features computed from authorized inputs: field matches, behavior counts/composition, grouping and sequence positions.
Shared and task-conditioned representations, prediction readouts and registered training-loss mechanisms.
architecture_search.lineage: parent_trial identifies a comparison and evidence lineage; it does not require code or architectural inheritance. inherited_components may be empty when the whole model is replaced.
architecture_search.proposal_unit: A coherent mechanism hypothesis can require several coordinated structural changes. Build that structure and plan component, replacement or factorial controls to identify where its value comes from.
architecture_search.evidence: Evaluate predictive quality, mechanism support, nearest-work differences and measured cost. Compare new unified candidates against their closest architectural alternatives as well as the initial reference.
architecture_search.fixed_contracts: Available sample information, labels, data split, scoring, resource accounting and the frozen host training recipe remain shared. Internal architecture and readout design are candidate choices.
architecture_search.reference_use: UniRank comparison methods provide inspectable design references and nearest work. Agents choose and adapt mechanisms from local evidence.

protocol.test_policy: closed during research; any final suite must be frozen before held-out scoring
benchmark_deviations: DIN is the initial empirical reference; unified research candidates can use entirely different architectures.
One GPU per model; batch8192 per model (single-device rather than published distributed global batch).
Click AUC selects models, four-task mean AUC is auxiliary.
Validation includes every sample; upstream default drop_last may omit remainders.
In-process DataLoader (num_workers=0): container shared memory is512MiB; all compared runs use the same loading policy.

context.budget_scope: The research wall clock starts at the recorded dataset download/checksum completion. Earlier acquisition and setup costs are reported separately; every later preparation step, calibration, agent call, failure, training/control and scoring job counts.

knowledge_review.policy: Evaluate relevant external references against local evidence; adoption is optional. Missing source detail and negative transfer remain explicit.
knowledge_review.proposal_output: Add top-level knowledge_assessments: [{knowledge_id, decision: used|considered|rejected|unresolved, rationale, transformed_mechanism, variant_names, nearest_work_difference, falsifier}]. Cover retrieved industry cards; identify the concrete changed mechanism for used cards. This is provenance, not causal proof.
knowledge_review.reflection: Review the latest knowledge-usage.json alongside outcomes; distinguish declared use, executed changes, mechanism evidence and unresolved attribution.

assessments.rationale: Retrieved for the observed failure of compressed exchange. Inspected pinned benchmark query mixing, cross-attention and fusion; original-method paper text unavailable. Layer-wise field/history feedback is a nearby mechanism to test, not evidence of transfer.
assessments.transformed_mechanism: Replace latent attention with full-width shared DIN local reads. A field/history MLP feeds a query residual and matching-key gate into the second read; use original values and strict masks. Factorial Q/W controls isolate these feedback edges.
assessments.nearest_work_difference: No per-head K/V maps, sequence FFN, token-specific SwiGLU or softmax retrieval. Matching-key modulation preserves original values. Differences checked against pinned benchmark code only; originality versus the original paper is unverified.
assessments.falsifier: Nonpositive feedback simple effects or A11-A00 fail the proposed local benefit; nonpositive factorial interaction fails complementarity.

assessments.rationale: Search retrieved fixed/conditioned queries and recent/earlier history partitioning. Available diagnostics do not distinguish recency utility; adding partitions would introduce another unmeasured mechanism.
assessments.transformed_mechanism: No partitions, fixed learned queries or heterogeneous token mixing adopted.
assessments.nearest_work_difference: Candidate uses two native target-derived reads over the same full visible prefix. No HeMix reproduction or priority claim.
assessments.falsifier: Authorized recency diagnostics and matched partition/query controls could justify reconsideration; this batch cannot refute HeMix.

assessments.rationale: Reviewed latest declared usage together with all exchange/mass/value outcomes. Its inherited rank-32 cross-attention trajectory has not beaten DIN. A raw-value residual did not beat the best mass ancestor; declaration of usage is not mechanism confirmation.
assessments.transformed_mechanism: Replace that latent retrieval family in this batch; do not retain EST-style cross-attention or field-specific FFNs.
assessments.nearest_work_difference: Native-width local scoring and original values replace projected dot-attention; the bundle comparison cannot attribute historical deficits to one component.
assessments.falsifier: A later matched attention/scorer replacement may overturn the working explanation; current negative transfer does not refute EST itself.

assessments.rationale: Reviewed prior exchange writer contrasts and latest usage. They support some single-seed simple effects but a negative Q-by-W interaction in round zero, and do not establish effectiveness of INFNet or complementarity of its channels.
assessments.transformed_mechanism: No latent hub or task-specific broadcast adopted. The new W intervention is a bounded gate on native matching keys, with original values unchanged.
assessments.nearest_work_difference: Direct field/history-conditioned matching has no hub tokens, task hubs, action-mask routing or latent event-value rewrite. Related feedback concepts are inherited from local trajectories rather than a claimed INFNet reproduction.
assessments.falsifier: A11-A10 and A01-A00 directly test the new key gate; even positive results would not establish INFNet transfer.

assessments.rationale: Latest usage considered raw-history exposure, but the subsequent raw-value residual did not improve the best mass ancestor. Full flattening would change positional treatment and dense capacity together.
assessments.transformed_mechanism: No flattened sequence, chunk tokenizer or UniMixing adopted; retain direct original-value pooling.
assessments.nearest_work_difference: Native attention-dependent summaries keep fixed output width independent of history length.
assessments.falsifier: A matched raw-history/flattening control remains a future question if native feedback fails; current results do not refute UniMixer.

assessments.rationale: Latest usage reviewed; no local evidence isolates a need for joint full attention, progressive reduction or mixed token FFNs.
assessments.transformed_mechanism: None of those components adopted in this proposal.
assessments.nearest_work_difference: Two shared local retrieval passes with a compact field MLP and preserved values instead of a joint token Transformer.
assessments.falsifier: A future matched joint-attention alternative could supersede this design; no ineffectiveness claim follows from current trials.

assessments.rationale: No authorized frequency diagnostics support changing identifier capacity now, and doing so would confound the feedback contrast.
assessments.transformed_mechanism: No table expansion; embedding dimension stays 16.
assessments.nearest_work_difference: This batch changes dense information flow only, with identical sparse capacity in all cells.
assessments.falsifier: Frequency-group evidence and a separate matched capacity/cost study could justify revisiting this choice; this is not a rejection of external reported effectiveness.

latest_knowledge_usage.limits: A declared source-to-code link is provenance, not a causal estimate of knowledge value or a novelty score.

source_access.query: context conditioned local activation field history DMR DIN

source_access.version: original paper link recorded at UniRank git:90bb99a60724e975ec565836266fd86dcad0039d

reference_format: Use allowed_observation_ids verbatim for local evidence. Descriptive references are accepted when they contain a complete known ID. Correct any previous_runtime_error before submitting; its failed costs remain charged.
action: Read candidate.py and baseline_reference.py, diagnose an observed limitation, check primary nearest work, and implement a feasible candidate. Write proposal.json containing study (matching study_schema), parent_trial (existing trial ID), and variants (1-4 objects with distinct name, file basename ending .py, role candidate/control, config object, and note). At least one candidate is required. Add key ablations or matched controls for the claimed mechanism when feasible; reference existing matched trials as controls where justified. Each variant is a standalone module. Do not run training. New architecture choices come from evidence; industry cards do not mandate them.

candidate_api.Model: Model(feature_map, model_id=..., gpu=0, **kwargs) -> torch.nn.Module; optional MultiTaskModel utilities. forward(inputs) returns {label+"_pred": probability [B,1]} for all four tasks. Host places the module on the assigned GPU.
candidate_api.architecture_scope: Whole-model design for unified modeling. Model need not inherit the initial reference, retain its pooling, or use separate task towers; representations, interactions, routing and readout can all be replaced.
candidate_api.lineage: parent_trial records the empirical comparison and evidence lineage. A complete rewrite may have no inherited architectural components.
candidate_api.proposal_unit: Coordinated structural changes implementing one coherent mechanism are allowed; isolate their effects through planned replacement, component or factorial controls.
candidate_api.meta: Read-only UniRank FeatureMap: features (ordered specs, sources, vocab_size), labels, data_dir. Full framework reference files are available through tools.py.
batch: batch_dict: categorical user/context features int64[B]; current labels and lookup metadata are removed by host
item_dict: item_id,cate_id,campaign_id,customer_id,brand,price_bucket,action, each int64[B,101]; last position is current target, preceding100 are pre-padded history
history_mask: float 0/1 [B,100]; four task masks: [B,100]; use only masked history
Target action is always zero (unknown/padding), never a current label. Historical feedback policy is frozen in protocol.history_policy.
Historical item_id is a previous advertisement ID. Shopping events used to create auxiliary labels are only matched by user/category/brand.
No raw timestamps, event-time deltas, raw user IDs, full future histories, current labels or global sample indexes are supplied to forward.
candidate_api.primary: Validation is_click ROC-AUC. All four AUC/Logloss values and mean AUC are reported; auxiliary mean is not the selection score.
optional: Literal CONFIG dict for model architecture only; all frozen host parameters are rejected.
Model.training_loss(inputs, probabilities[B,4], train_labels[B,4]) -> finite differentiable scalar; labels supplied only during training. Default is sum of four unweighted BCEs.
candidate_api.ownership: Edit candidate modules/proposal only. No filesystem/network operations in model source. Imports: torch,numpy,math,typing,copy,functools,collections,itertools,dataclasses,contextlib,unirank,model_zoo. Host owns training, input filtering and scoring.
candidate_api.local_checks: Coding jail has no torch; check syntax/source there. Host trains and scores. Do not install or train inside coding jail.
candidate_api.training: From scratch; same frozen data, seed, epochs, batch, history limit and dense AdamW / embedding Adagrad. Architecture may be rewritten completely. Retain causal controls and account for added parameters/computation.
